newsitem.title: CONGO: Mobutu, Mandela expected in Congo by 1000 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu, Mandela expected in Congo by 1000 GMT.

text.p: Presidents Mobutu Sese Seko of Zaire and Nelson Mandela of South Africa were expected in the Congolese port of Pointe Noire by 1000 GMT on Friday in advance of Mobutu's meeting at sea with rebel leader Laurent Kabila, Zairean officials said.
U.S. Navy helicopters overflew the airport at Pointe Noire on Friday morning as part of preparations. Mandela left South Africa for Pointe Noire earlier on Friday.
Airport sources in Kinshasa said Mobutu's plane was still on the tarmac in the Zairean capital at 0800 GMT but Pointe Noire is less than one hour's flying away.

Kabila, whose forces now control more than three quarters of Zaire, left on Friday morning for the Angolan capital Luanda, where he will meet up with South African Deputy Minister Thabo Mbeki and then fly by helicopter to Pointe Noire.
The South Africans are trying to arrange the meeting aboard the South African naval vessel the Outeniqua, somewhere off the coast of Congo or Gabon.
